verdict.rationale: Stagehand is presented as an SDK/library (with an MCP server for agent tool-use) rather than a hosted HTTP task-submission API; the probe explicitly found no OpenAPI/REST endpoint (openapi paths all 404), and no docs describe submitting a task and polling or receiving a webhook result. Evidence shows Browserbase-hosted browser sessions and MCP/stdio integration, but nothing matching the described async HTTP task API.
